mostWorthwhile.text: The grazing impact and subsequent moon formation were most worthwhile: the debris had a clear physical path to a new object.

leastWorthwhile.text: The slow collision that grew the young world was straightforward and less memorable than the contrasting impacts that followed.

surprise.text: The first large impact melted and enlarged the world rather than producing the orbiting debris I expected; a later grazing impact did that.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely purposeless, though the menu did not explain why the first large-world collision differed from the next until after each result.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to follow the scattered fragments and see how their paths develop, especially after the contrasting collision outcomes.
